protocol.input: Primary native condition: supplied LADI resolution for Luna and MITLL (with checkpoint preprocessing); Jev aspect-preserving resize to its supported limit. Secondary matched condition: all arms receive the same Jev-sized pixels before model-specific preprocessing. Preserve source pixels and log input dimensions/hashes per arm.
protocol.output: 12 independent positive-class probabilities; no softmax across labels
protocol.development: validate adapters and freeze rubric on validation only
protocol.test: use official test split without prompt or threshold tuning
protocol.errors: retain failures and report coverage; never coerce failures into negative labels
protocol.reproducibility: pin checkpoint revisions, served API versions, rubric hash, image hashes and row IDs before running
